title: Cardpack Thresholding: Trim Console cost/trace into surgical MVP
creator: Lena Park
description: We need to reduce the console surface for Route Cost + Trace features into a tightly scoped, testable MVP that meets SLOs for time-to-insight while keeping token and instrumentation costs bounded. This ticket defines the surgical cuts (cardpack thresholding), acceptance criteria, and rollback/fallback behaviors for the initial launch slice.
background: Recent roadmap review prioritized reducing telemetry ingestion and card complexity to control cost while shipping a usable insights surface. PM + Eng + Design alignment happened 2025-02-06. Original scope included 8 card types, full trace flamegraph integration, and per-route cost breakdowns with hourly granularity. That scope exceeds time and cost constraints for the alpha channel.
original_scope: 8 insight cards (latency, p50/p95, error-rate, cost-by-model, cost-by-route, token-usage, deployment-events, trace-flamegraph), per-route hourly cost breakdown, full trace link-outs to distributed traces, and sampling at 100% for first 48 hours.
trimmed_scope: Ship a 3-card 'cardpack' for MVP: (1) Route summary (p50/p95 + error-rate), (2) Cost snapshot (daily aggregated route cost, top 5 routes), (3) Trace entry (single-span preview + link to OnCall trace viewer). Sampling set to adaptive 5-20% based on QPS. Hourly granularity deferred to post-MVP. No flamegraph in MVP.
acceptance_criteria: Cardpack surfaces visible in Console > Insights > Routes for accounts with telemetry enabled
Route summary card shows computed p50/p95 and error-rate for last 24h with < 1s query latency under expected dataset
Cost snapshot returns daily aggregated cost per route and highlights top-5 cost contributors; delta computed versus previous 7-day baseline
Trace entry card returns a representative sampled span and a deep-link to centralized trace viewer; deep-link must open with context (trace id, route id)
Adaptive sampling configured and documented (default 5%, increases to 20% for routes > 200 QPS), with measurable ingestion reduction versus baseline
Backend endpoints include feature-flag gating to allow immediate rollback of cost card and sampling adjustments without deploy
SLO: console render time for the Insights page <= 1.5s p95 for orgs with < 100k requests/day
Automated e2e smoke tests covering card availability, sample deep-link flow, and basic cost delta assertion
Clear fallback: if any cost query times out, card displays cached 1-hour-old snapshot and logs a metric for timeouts
decisions: Drop flamegraph and full trace integration from MVP to avoid instrumentation and UI complexity
Reduce card set to 3 highest-value cards to limit query volume and front-end rendering complexity
Implement adaptive sampling instead of full-volume capture to reduce ingestion cost while preserving signal
Expose runtime feature-flag to toggle cost-card and sampling thresholds for rapid rollback or ramp-up

rollout_plan: Stage 1: internal dogfood org (1 org) for 72h; Stage 2: opt-in beta for 10 paying accounts with usage variety for 7 days; Stage 3: general availability with default off for free tier. Use feature flag for percentage rollout and quick rollback if ingestion or latency thresholds breach. Monitor ingestion-cost, card render time, and sampling errors.
